option_groups_custom_shape.name: option_groups_custom_shape
option_groups_custom_shape.value: "option_groups"."kind" <> 'custom' or ("option_groups"."input" = 'number' and "option_groups"."authored_unit" is not null and "option_groups"."include_in_sku_code" = false)

option_values_delta_shape.name: option_values_delta_shape
option_values_delta_shape.value:
case "option_values"."delta_type"
            when 'none'    then "option_values"."delta_minor" is null and "option_values"."delta_bp" is null
            when 'percent' then "option_values"."delta_minor" is null and "option_values"."delta_bp" is not null
            else "option_values"."delta_minor" is not null and "option_values"."delta_bp" is null
          end

option_values_delta_whole_units.name: option_values_delta_whole_units
option_values_delta_whole_units.value:
("option_values"."delta_minor" is null or "option_values"."delta_minor" % 100 = 0)
          and ("option_values"."delta_bp" is null or "option_values"."delta_bp" % 100 = 0)

product_version_options_sku_shape.name: product_version_options_sku_shape
product_version_options_sku_shape.value:
"product_version_options"."group_kind" <> 'sku' or (
            "product_version_options"."default_value_code" is not null
            and "product_version_options"."min_um" is null and "product_version_options"."max_um" is null
            and "product_version_options"."step_um" is null and "product_version_options"."default_um" is null
          )

product_version_options_custom_shape.name: product_version_options_custom_shape
product_version_options_custom_shape.value:
"product_version_options"."group_kind" <> 'custom' or (
            "product_version_options"."default_value_code" is null
            and "product_version_options"."min_um" is not null and "product_version_options"."max_um" is not null
            and "product_version_options"."step_um" is not null and "product_version_options"."default_um" is not null
          )

product_version_options_grid.name: product_version_options_grid
product_version_options_grid.value:
"product_version_options"."group_kind" <> 'custom' or (
            "product_version_options"."min_um" > 0
            and "product_version_options"."step_um" > 0
            and "product_version_options"."step_um" % 25 = 0
            and "product_version_options"."min_um" <= "product_version_options"."max_um"
            and "product_version_options"."min_um" % "product_version_options"."step_um" = 0
            and ("product_version_options"."max_um" - "product_version_options"."min_um") % "product_version_options"."step_um" = 0
            and "product_version_options"."default_um" between "product_version_options"."min_um" and "product_version_options"."max_um"
            and ("product_version_options"."default_um" - "product_version_options"."min_um") % "product_version_options"."step_um" = 0
          )

auth_tokens_email_target_shape.name: auth_tokens_email_target_shape
auth_tokens_email_target_shape.value:
case "auth_tokens"."purpose"
            when 'email_verification' then "auth_tokens"."user_email_id" is not null
            else "auth_tokens"."user_email_id" is null
          end

oauth_states_return_to_is_local.name: oauth_states_return_to_is_local
oauth_states_return_to_is_local.value:
left("oauth_states"."return_to", 1) = '/'
          and left("oauth_states"."return_to", 2) <> '//'
          and left("oauth_states"."return_to", 2) <> ('/' || chr(92))

notifications_pending_coalesce_key.name: notifications_pending_coalesce_key
notifications_pending_coalesce_key.where: status = 'pending' and coalesce_key is not null

notifications_status_shape.name: notifications_status_shape
notifications_status_shape.value:
case "notifications"."status"
            when 'sent'       then "notifications"."sent_at" is not null and "notifications"."dead_at" is null
            when 'dead'       then "notifications"."dead_at" is not null and "notifications"."attempt_count" > 0
            when 'suppressed' then "notifications"."suppressed_reason" is not null and "notifications"."recipient_key" is null
            else "notifications"."sent_at" is null and "notifications"."dead_at" is null
          end

order_events_status_known.name: order_events_status_known
order_events_status_known.value:
("order_events"."from_status" is null or "order_events"."from_status" in ('draft', 'awaiting_payment', 'production_confirmed', 'in_production', 'awaiting_installation', 'delivered', 'redesign', 'cancelled', 'superseded'))
          and ("order_events"."to_status" is null or "order_events"."to_status" in ('draft', 'awaiting_payment', 'production_confirmed', 'in_production', 'awaiting_installation', 'delivered', 'redesign', 'cancelled', 'superseded'))

order_events_status_pair_shape.name: order_events_status_pair_shape
order_events_status_pair_shape.value:
case
            when "order_events"."to_status" is null then "order_events"."from_status" is null
            when "order_events"."from_status" is null then "order_events"."seq" = 1
            else true
          end

order_events_actor_shape.name: order_events_actor_shape
order_events_actor_shape.value:
case "order_events"."actor_kind"
            when 'customer' then "order_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "order_events"."actor_guest_id" is null
            when 'staff'    then "order_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "order_events"."actor_guest_id" is null
            when 'guest'    then "order_events"."actor_guest_id" is not null and "order_events"."actor_user_id" is null
            else "order_events"."actor_user_id" is null and "order_events"."actor_guest_id" is null
          end

orders_draft_has_no_contract.name: orders_draft_has_no_contract
orders_draft_has_no_contract.value:
"orders"."status" <> 'draft'
          or ("orders"."submitted_at" is null and "orders"."frozen_at" is null and "orders"."document_id" is null)

orders_redesign_has_a_contract.name: orders_redesign_has_a_contract
orders_redesign_has_a_contract.value:
"orders"."status" <> 'redesign'
          or ("orders"."submitted_at" is not null and "orders"."frozen_at" is not null and "orders"."document_id" is not null)

orders_submitted_shape.name: orders_submitted_shape
orders_submitted_shape.value:
("orders"."submitted_at" is null) = ("orders"."order_no" is null)
          and ("orders"."submitted_at" is null) = ("orders"."document_id" is null)
          and ("orders"."submitted_at" is null) = ("orders"."grand_total_thb_minor" is null)
          and ("orders"."submitted_at" is null) = ("orders"."scheduled_deposit_thb_minor" is null)

orders_submitted_has_a_contact_channel.name: orders_submitted_has_a_contact_channel
orders_submitted_has_a_contact_channel.value: "orders"."submitted_at" is null or "orders"."contact_email" is not null

orders_frozen_after_submitted.name: orders_frozen_after_submitted
orders_frozen_after_submitted.value:
"orders"."frozen_at" is null
          or ("orders"."submitted_at" is not null and "orders"."frozen_at" >= "orders"."submitted_at")

orders_money_nonnegative.name: orders_money_nonnegative
orders_money_nonnegative.value:
("orders"."net_thb_minor" is null or "orders"."net_thb_minor" >= 0)
          and ("orders"."vat_thb_minor" is null or "orders"."vat_thb_minor" >= 0)
